gaps.where: Homes tab list; Matches tab (New / Sent / Skipped); a listing's Facts, Photos and Description pages and the deal page's listing card (price, page state, signed-off description)
gaps.gap: Real for homes and matches. Each HomeOut (realestate_list_homes) and each match (realestate_matches) carries a full MlsOut: up to 12 photo URLs, the MLS description and the display notice and logo. Neither input has a limit or offset (homes takes only includeRemoved, matches only state), so a few MLS-found homes pass 16,000 characters and the rest are cut. The get_listing part is weaker than stated. page and listPriceCents come after choices, photos and feed and can be cut on a listing with many photos, but realestate_listing_marketing (page), realestate_listing_prices (price) and realestate_listing_flyer (signed-off description, once live on the MLS) give them separately. Only the signed-off description before the MLS goes live has no other route.
gaps.fix: Add `limit` (default 10) and `offset` to HomesInput (schemas.ts:1298) and MatchesInput (schemas.ts:3599). For the AI, return MlsOut without photos, description and display, for example with a `brief: z.boolean().default(false)` input the AI tools set, or a lighter MlsBriefOut. In ListingOut (schemas.ts:2502), move page, listPriceCents and description ahead of choices, photos and feed, and have the listing.get handler return keys in that order.
